# Construction Dive

> > Construction Dive delivers breaking news and analysis on commercial building, infrastructure projects, workforce development, and market trends shaping the construction industry.

Construction Dive covers major contractors like Skanska, DPR, Gilbane, Rosendin, and Clayco, tracking industry developments from apprenticeship programs and labor challenges to data center construction and mass timber innovation. The publication provides market outlooks, project announcements, and policy analysis for construction professionals.

## Key Topics

- Market outlook and industry trends
- Tariffs and policy uncertainty
- Labor and immigration challenges
- Workforce development and apprenticeships
- Commercial building projects
- Data center construction
- Infrastructure and public works
- Mass timber and sustainable construction
- Contractor reports and acquisitions
- California construction market
- Skilled trades training
- Major contractors: Skanska, DPR, Gilbane, Rosendin, Clayco
- Construction technology and innovation
- Healthcare and hospitality construction

- [The 9 largest commercial construction starts of August 2025](https://www.constructiondive.com/news/largest-commercial-construction-starts-august-2025-dodge/760797): August 2025's top commercial construction starts per Dodge Construction
- [2026's top construction conferences](https://www.constructiondive.com/news/2026s-top-construction-conferences/761559): Guide to 2026 construction industry conferences and trade show calendar
